The game's core premise is simple yet engaging: play on Blue, and after a few minutes, you'll unlock the opportunity to play on Fluido. In this comprehensive review and strategy guide, we'll take a closer look at the game's core gameplay mechanics, addictive features, visual style, beginner tips, advanced strategies, game modes, and much more.
